question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

GSLC, AMOF, UGRI, ?, IUXO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First two letter → (6) is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last two letters → (3) is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d746d674d7312aa92fe312d39cb26451d1647b88d4dc69bf51ba931dda91d2.png]
